subject: March Newsletter: 5 Ways to Audit Your API Usage Before Renewal
body:
Hi Wei,

Renewal season is here! Before you commit to a higher-tier plan, make sure you're actually using what you're paying for.

**5 Quick Audit Tips:**
1. Check your actual API call logs - not vendor estimates
2. Review data transfer patterns for anomalies
3. Compare month-over-month trends
4. Identify unused features in your current tier
5. Negotiate based on actual usage data

Many developers save 30-40% by doing a simple usage audit before renewal.

Read the full guide: https://saas-cost-optimizer.com/audit-guide

Cheers,
SaaS Cost Optimizer Team

subject: Re: Usage statistics export request
body:
Hi Wei,

Thank you for reaching out. Unfortunately, detailed usage logs (API call counts, data transfer breakdowns) are only available through our CLI dashboard or API endpoints. The web portal shows aggregated monthly summaries only.

For granular usage data, please use:
- CLI command: `datalytics usage --month 2026-01 --format json`
- API endpoint: GET /v1/usage/detailed

If you need assistance interpreting the logs, our support team is happy to help.

Best,
DataLytics Support
